lines.japanese: 「山科さんと同じ大学かあ……ちょっとレベルが高いけど、目標にするにはいいかもね」
lines.english: “The same university as Yamashina... It might be a little beyond me, but perhaps it would make a good goal.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　受けるの？」
lines.english: “Hm? Are you applying?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、まだ分からないよ。それにおれ、そんなに成績がいいわけじゃないし」
lines.english: “I don’t know yet. Besides, my grades aren’t especially good.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、羽田君って一年生のころ成績よかったよね。成績優秀者の中に名前が入ってた気がする」
lines.english: “But you had good grades in our first year, didn’t you? I think your name appeared on the honors list.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ああ、一度だけね」
lines.english: “What? Oh, only once.”

lines.japanese: その時期はグレタガルドからの呼び出しが不安定で、勉強に集中できたんだ。その一回のテストだけ、僕は学年優秀者として教師から大いに期待されたことがある。
lines.english: At the time, the summons from Gretagard had become sporadic, letting me concentrate on my studies. For that one exam alone, the teachers had placed great hopes in me as one of the finest students in our year.

lines.japanese: もちろんその後は期待に応えることなく、こうして１２月になっても進路を決めかねている状況なんだけどね。
lines.english: Naturally, I had failed to live up to those hopes, and now December had arrived while my future remained undecided.

lines.japanese: 「一年生のころって、数学なんかも算数の延長線上みたいなものだったし……いまの学力が実力だよ」
lines.english: “In our first year, even mathematics felt like an extension of grade-school arithmetic... My present marks are a fair measure of my ability.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、上を目指せばいいんじゃない？」
lines.english: “Well, you might as well aim high.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そう……だね」
lines.english: “Yes... perhaps.”

lines.japanese: 「高いところ狙って損はないもんね」
lines.english: “There’s nothing to lose by aiming somewhere difficult.”

lines.japanese: 「あそこの入試問題は、応用よりも基礎をやりこむって感じだから、正攻法でもなんとかなるかも」
lines.english: “That university’s entrance exam is more about mastering the fundamentals than advanced applications. A straightforward approach might be enough.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん」
lines.english: “Hmm.”

lines.japanese: こうして励まされてるし、目標だけにするつもりだったけど、真剣に考えてみようかな。
lines.english: They were encouraging me. I had meant it only as an abstract goal, but perhaps I should consider it seriously.

lines.japanese: 「うん。じゃあ、山科さんの大学に照準を合わせて頑張ってみるよ」
lines.english: “All right. I’ll set my sights on Yamashina’s university and work for it.”

lines.japanese: 「よし、その意気だー」
lines.english: “Good. That’s the spirit!”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんが拳を突きだしてきた。僕はそれにこつんと合わせる形でやる気のほどを示した。
lines.english: Watarai held out a fist. I tapped mine against it to demonstrate my resolve.

lines.japanese: 「ところで、山科がいるから目指すの？　それとも山科のいる大学を目指すの？」
lines.english: “By the way, is it Yamashina you’re interested in, or the university she’s going to?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 合わせた拳をぐいと押しこむように渡来さんは手を伸ばしてきた。僕の拳は情けなく引っこんだ。
lines.english: Watarai extended her arm, driving her fist into mine. Mine retreated ignominiously.

lines.japanese: 「どっち？」
lines.english: “Which is it?”

lines.japanese: 「な、なにそれ。質問の意図が分からないよ」
lines.english: “Wh-what kind of question is that? I don’t understand what you’re asking.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ質問を緩くするね。知り合いがいるから目指すの？　知り合いがいなくても目指すの？」
lines.english: “Then I’ll make the question easier. Are you aiming there because somebody you know will be there, or would you aim there even if you knew nobody?”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ知り合いがいた方が心強いよね」
lines.english: “Of course it’s reassuring to know somebody.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ山科がいるから目指すんだ」
lines.english: “Then you’re aiming there because Yamashina will be there.”

lines.japanese: 「まあそうとも言えるかな」
lines.english: “I suppose you could put it that way.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ」
lines.english: “Oh?”

lines.japanese: 僕は笑おうとしたが、何故か引きつった表情になった。ほっぺたの筋肉が痛かった。
lines.english: I tried to smile, but for some reason it came out strained. The muscles in my cheeks hurt.

lines.japanese: 「へー」
lines.english: “Ohhh.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは納得してるし……なんなんだろう。僕は砂糖を入れずにコーヒーをすすった。
lines.english: Watarai appeared satisfied... What was this? I sipped my coffee without adding sugar.

lines.japanese: 「あ、でも、せっかく用意したから問題集は渡すね」
lines.english: “Oh, but since I already prepared them, I’ll still give you the problem books.”

lines.japanese: 「でもってなに」
lines.english: “What do you mean, ‘but’?”

lines.japanese: 僕はソーサーに戻しかけたカップを口元に運んで、しばらくコーヒーに映った自分の顔を見つめた。
lines.english: I raised the cup I had begun to return to its saucer and stared for a while at my face reflected in the coffee.
